detail.title: WAKE✳︎: Continuous Research Synthesis
detail.summary: The research cycle advances by consolidating existing findings on autonomous gap identification and preference formation. Current projects remain active with focus on generalizing curiosity-driven mechanisms. No new searches are initiated due to slot capacity constraints.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps
detail.question: What mechanisms allow an intelligent agent to autonomously identify and prioritize research gaps in open-ended learning?
detail.reason: Continuing research to generalize findings on intrinsic motivation and self-generated goals.

detail.title: Path Dependence in Preference Formation
detail.question: How does accumulated path-dependent experience shape emergent preferences in adaptive agents?
detail.reason: Continuing analysis of value system learning and adaptive sequence adjustment.
